notes: Top-level may be wrapped as {"sections": [...]} (default) or {"blocks": [...]} (alias accepted).
Each section must have `type: string` matching a canonical block type or alias.
Props can be flat on the section (recommended) or nested under `config` / `props`.
`id` is optional but recommended for stable diffs.
`SECTION_TYPE_MAP` in solid-frontend/src/components/cms/PageRenderer.tsx resolves kebab-case / snake_case / PascalCase / aliases into the registry components.
